personality: 4 Tactile / Playful LIGHT (constrained to Premium Family tone: cream, deep green, mint, gold)
personality_one_liner: A warm, reassuring, and premium familial app featuring large rounded cards, soft contrast, and highly legible typography to make meal planning and pantry management effortless.

spacing.rule: Maintain generous breathing room to avoid any medical or administrative feel. Use lg (16pt) or xl (24pt) padding inside cards.

do's: Use only for the bottom tab bar and sticky CTAs to maintain a premium feel while scrolling large cards.
dont's: Do not use on generic list items, input fields, or static dashboard cards to preserve the opaque, warm cream aesthetic.

screens.name: Accueil
screens.purpose: Home screen featuring 3 large, highly visible path cards to start the user journey.

states.loading: Centered spinner with a mint green tint.
states.empty: N/A - Static paths are always available.
states.error: Warm error message asking to reload.

screens.layout: Vertical list of 3 large rounded cards (lg radius, white on cream background). 'Pour moi', 'Pour mon foyer', 'Avec ce que j'ai'. Highlight the last one using the mint green (brandSecondary) or a gold badge.

screens.name: Réserves
screens.purpose: Pantry inventory input screen with 4 accessible methods.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty minimal plate/pantry with a warm CTA to start adding items.
states.error: Error toast with a retry button.

screens.layout: Grid of 4 large touch-friendly buttons for input methods (Écrire, Parler, Photographier, Scanner code-barres) followed by a list of recently added items. Use Phosphor icons sized 24-28pt.

screens.name: Confirmation
screens.purpose: Consolidate pantry additions with calibrated quantity sliders.

states.loading: Spinner overlaid on the consolidation list.
states.empty: N/A - Only reached when items are present.

screens.layout: List of detected items. Each row contains a title, a source badge (e.g. Open Food Facts), and a calibrated slider beneath it to adjust real vs total quantity (e.g., 250g / 500g). Sticky primary CTA at the bottom to confirm.

screens.name: Choix_Repas
screens.purpose: Filters and selectors to plan the meals.

states.empty: Illustration of a family table if no preferences set yet.

screens.layout: Use pill controls and segmented selectors for number of people (1-6), meals (1-4), and cuisine types. Large padding and easy tap areas. Sticky 'Générer les repas' CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Vérification
screens.purpose: Compatibility check between generated recipe needs and actual pantry stock.
screens.layout: List of required ingredients. Each item features a visual progress gauge (using mint green and deep green) representing what is in stock vs what is needed. Highlight missing items clearly but warmly.

screens.name: Recette

states.loading: Skeleton blocks for image and text.

screens.layout: Hero image at the top with a top-to-bottom gradient scrim. Large title, metadata chips (time, people). Ingredients list and step-by-step instructions in white surfaceSecondary cards. Sticky bottom CTA to 'Mettre à jour le stock' after cooking.

screens.name: Suivi
screens.purpose: Nutritional tracking, budget, and energy dashboard.

states.empty: Empty state illustration of a clean kitchen, prompting users to log their first meal.

screens.layout: Dashboard layout but avoid clinical look. Large rounded cards. One card for a nutritional radar chart, another for a weekly curve, and smaller cards for saved budget and cooking energy metrics.

hero_meal.alt: A white plate topped with french cuisine dish

cooking_family.alt: Family cooking together in a warm modern kitchen

empty_pantry.alt: Empty minimalist plate representing zero food waste

modern_pantry.alt: Modern minimal pantry with neat shelves

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the selected color palette: off-white/cream base, deep green primary, mint green secondary/success, and subtle gold accents. No indigo, blue, or purple allowed anywhere.
Utilize large, rounded cards (lg: 24pt radius) and maintain generous spacing (md/lg/xl) to emulate a warm, human, non-administrative feel reminiscent of Jow's aesthetic.
Implement calibrated sliders for the Confirmation screen to handle real vs total quantity input beautifully.
For the recipe screen hero image, ensure a gradient scrim is present to guarantee text readability.

When building the Suivi (Tracking) screen, incorporate the nutritional radar chart within a clean white card against the cream background. Keep it looking familial and friendly rather than like a sterile dashboard.
Ensure touch targets are large (minimum 44x44pt) throughout all flows, particularly for the 4 pantry input methods.
All copy and placeholders should be written in French as per the problem statement.
